svg.title: Four machines. Four independent players.
svg.desc: P1 hosts on a separate computer. P2, P3 and P4 each have their own computer and six-button controller. Three bidirectional links carry inputs through P1. P1/P3 are team A; P2/P4 are team B. Every machine runs the full match and rollback. Architecture diagram; a four-machine internet playtest is still outstanding.

g.aria-label: Every machine runs the full match + rollback.
Local synchronization checked; four-machine internet playtest pending.
